code: body { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ff007f, #00f0ff, #ffea00, #ff007f); background-size: 400% 400%; animation: discoPlenum 2s ease-in-out infinite; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.8); } @keyframes discoPlenum { 0% { background-position: 0% 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px #ff007f; } 33% { background-position: 100% 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px #00f0ff; } 66% { background-position: 50% 100%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px #ffea00; } 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px #ff007f; } } .message { border: none !important; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); transform: scale(1.02); transition: transform 0.1s ease-in-out; } .message:hover { transform: scale(1.05) rotate(1deg); }

body { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ff00ff, #00ffff, #ff00ff); background-size: 400% 400%; animation: discoFloor 0.5s infinite alternate, ringPulse 0.8s infinite ease-out !important; } @keyframes ringPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px 80px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); } } @keyframes discoFloor { 0% { background-position: 0% 50%; } 100% { background-position: 100% 50%; } }

body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,0,128,0.25) 0%, rgba(255,215,0,0.15) 50%, transparent 100%); mix-blend-mode: overlay; animation: bassPulse 1.2s infinite alternate cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; } @keyframes bassPulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.4; } 100% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 0.9; } }
